units.source_text: 入大学的夕雾，近来胸中一直烦闷，饭也吃不下去。

en.t: Since entering the university, Yugiri had lately felt constantly oppressed at heart and could not even eat.

units.source_text: 心情郁结，书也不能读，每天只是忧心忡忡地躺着。

en.t: His feelings were knotted with gloom; he could not read his books, and each day he only lay there weighed down by worry.

units.source_text: 此时想出门去散散心，便闲步到二条院，各处观玩。

en.t: At this point he thought he would go out to clear his mind, so he strolled idly to Nijo-in and looked around here and there.

units.source_text: 他的相貌异常秀丽，仪态十分优雅，青年侍女们看见了都赞美不已。

en.t: His looks were extraordinarily beautiful and his bearing was very graceful, so the young serving women could not stop praising him when they saw him.

units.source_text: 但他走到紫姬的住处，连帘前也不敢走近。

en.t: But when he came to Lady Murasaki's residence, he did not even dare approach the front of the curtain.

units.source_text: 这是因为源氏自己已有切身经验，深恐发生意外，所以不让他和紫姬接近。

en.t: This was because Genji himself had painful firsthand experience and, deeply afraid that something unexpected might happen, would not let him come near Lady Murasaki.

units.source_text: 紫姬的侍女们自然也避远他了。

en.t: Naturally, Lady Murasaki's attendants also kept their distance from him.

units.source_text: 但今天因为迎接舞姬，各处纷乱，夕雾也就混进紫姬的西殿里去了。

en.t: But today, because they were receiving the dancer and everywhere was in confusion, Yugiri slipped into Lady Murasaki's western pavilion.

units.source_text: 舞姬由众侍女扶下车子以后，走进边门前临时设立的屏风背后去休息一会。

en.t: After the dancer was helped down from her carriage by many attendants, she went behind a screen temporarily set up before the side gate to rest for a while.

units.source_text: 夕雾便走近去，向屏风内窥看，但见这舞姬似觉疲倦，把身子横着。

en.t: Yugiri then went closer and peered inside the screen, where he saw that the dancer seemed tired and was lying down.

units.source_text: 看她的年龄，和云居雁相仿，个子比她高些。

en.t: Judging by her age, she was about the same as Kumoi no Kari, though a little taller than she was.

units.source_text: 神采焕发，风流娴雅之相，竟比云居雁较胜一筹。

en.t: She had a radiant spirit and an elegant, refined charm, and unexpectedly seemed a shade superior to Kumoi no Kari.

units.source_text: 此时天色已黑，不能详细观看，但觉大体上十分肖似云居雁。

en.t: By then it was already dark, so he could not look closely, but overall she seemed very much like Kumoi no Kari.

units.source_text: 并非爱情已经移注在她身上，又觉似乎一见，终不满意，便伸手去拉她的衣裾。

en.t: It was not that his love had already shifted to her, but one glimpse left him unsatisfied, so he reached out and tugged at the hem of her robe.

units.source_text: 舞姬不知何事，心甚惊诧。

en.t: The dancer did not know what was happening and was greatly startled at heart.
Yugiri sent her a poem, saying:
